questions.question: In his letter to the church at Philippi, Paul urged two women, Euodia and Syntyche, to do what?

answers.text: Agree with each other in the Lord
Come and visit him right away
Choose new leaders for the church

questions.question: Which quality did Paul want the believers in Philippi to let everyone see in them?
Instead of being anxious, what did Paul tell the believers in Philippi to do with their requests?

answers.text: Present them to God with thanksgiving
Leave them unspoken and trust God
Present them to the elders with fasting

questions.question: Paul told the believers in Philippi that some things are worth being anxious about. True or false?
